labelAssociation.note: No <label for>. Label and field are siblings inside .cell, and BOTH carry data-name with the model's field name. That attribute is the stronger handle: it is the app's own identifier, unaffected by translation, where the visible label is the translated string. Prefer data-name; fall back to the label-anchored template when a field name is unknown.

regions.name: RecordTable
regions.note: Every row carries data-id (the record id) and every cell data-name (the field). A row is addressable by the text of its key cell without any nth.

naming.pattern: kebab-case .js under client/src/views/<scope>/<action>.js, templates mirrored under client/res/templates/

hazards.impact: every locator must come from a role, a visible label, or data-name. Nothing in the markup is test-owned, so a translation change can move a locator.
a route names no view; the controller picks one from clientDefs metadata at runtime. Source cannot say which elements a route renders — only the crawl can.
lists load 20 rows and append on 'Show more'. A row assertion must either search the loaded page or trigger loading; rowCount is not the result count.

notes: data-action attributes (215 files) mark every clickable behaviour in the markup. They are the app's own action vocabulary and make excellent scoping selectors inside a component class.
